**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (High-tier review: this changes posted G-code.)

### What looks good
- Scope matches the narrowed #901 (maintainer comment, 2026-11-11): each post states the unit it writes (mm); no `machine.units` read and no refusal. Unit source and inch output stay with #902.
- Fanuc / Haas / Mazak / Doosan DNM: `G21` sits in a block of its own at the end of `onOpen`, after `%`, the O word or name and the comment-only inverted-axis notes. That is before the first `G90 G54 G40 G49 G80` block, before `G43`, before any canned cycle or `G65` probe macro, and before any motion. `onOpen` runs once per program, so multi-section, tool-change and probing programs all get it ahead of everything else. None of these posts emits sub-programs (no `M98`/`M97`/`M99`). On Haas, the operator manual says G21 also checks Setting 9 and alarms on a mismatch, so a mismatch is refused where people can see it.
- Sinumerik 840D: `G710` is the right word. Siemens' public 840D sl programming manual lists G70/G71/G700/G710 as modal G group 13. G71 switches only geometric data; G710 also switches the length-based technology data (F). The word rides `startPreamble()` (`assets/posts/sinumerik.cps:351`), which every motion entry point (`onRapid`/`onLinear`/`onCircular`/`onCycle`/`onProbeMove`/`onProbeGuard`) calls first. G17 (group 6), G90 (14), G54 (8) and G40 (7) are in other groups, so sharing the block is allowed, and repeating it is harmless. No F word comes before it.
- Goldens, checked mechanically (`git diff origin/main...HEAD -U0 -- crates/app/tests/golden`): 112 changed lines = 76 added lines that are exactly `G21`, plus 18 Sinumerik lines `N10 G17 G90 G5x G40 G80` -> `N10 G17 G710 G90 G5x G40 G80` with the same N number. Nothing else changed, and no N word moved. In every non-Sinumerik golden, `G21` comes before the first motion line.
- `crates/app/tests/macro_b/mod.rs:226`: `G21` (code 210) joins the existing no-op mode words. `G20` stays unmodelled, so an inch program still errors and the probe checks lose nothing. The two `regression_models` counts (+1 each, 57->58 and 19->20) are the added `G21` line only.
- The pinning suite `post_unit_word` (5 tests) checks each post with no machine, a metric machine and an inch machine, through both the mounted and the raw-file door: the word comes before the first motion line and no inch word is written. The decision record `docs/decisions/901-post-unit-word.md` gives the choices and what was dropped. The PR body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #901`. No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. No process files, dependencies, `build.rs` or `.github` changes.

Not run: the full app suite set the quick-gate plan selects (the shared `macro_b` file maps to every app suite, but only `inverted_probe` includes it); camcraft-ui (untouched); the release-lane `--ignored` heavy lanes.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (non-blocking)
1. 840D edge, already recorded in the decisions file: a program with no section gets only the `onClose` `G53 Z` lift (`sinumerik.cps:588`) with no `G710`. It is a machine-coordinate retract, and the posting flow cannot reach it. Fine to leave for #902.
2. Siemens' manuals tie G700/G710 to the extended unit-switching functionality (machine data MD10260 on some software levels). Worth confirming on a real 840D when #902 adds inch output. It does not change this PR: G710 is the documented word for "lengths and feeds in mm".
3. The pinning tests live in `crates/app/tests/` beside the existing post suites rather than in `camcraft-post`. That is consistent with the repo today; noted only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
